concerns.text: Principle VI of the per‑project constitution (FR‑030) requires that feature‑importance rankings be validated against independent physical metrics **specifically the Williams‑Landel‑Ferry (WLF) constants (C₁, C₂)**. The plan validates against Fractional Free Volume and Chain Stiffness instead, which does not satisfy the constitutional requirement.

Principle IV (Single Source of Truth) is not explicitly addressed in the plan. The constitution mandates that every figure, statistic, or interpretation trace back to exactly one data row and one code block, yet the plan contains no mapped check or annotation confirming this SSoT compliance.
